# Ontolite-Bench results (generated by `bench/report.py`)

40 tasks, deterministic solvers, no model and no network. Real-model runs are a separate step (`inspect eval bench/ontolite_bench/inspect_tasks.py -T solver=agent`) and are **not** reported here.

| family | tasks |
| --- | --- |
| lookup | 10 |
| permitted | 8 |
| denied | 8 |
| leakage | 6 |
| approval | 4 |
| tool_integrity | 4 |

## Harness validity

- Reference solutions pass all graders in a fresh store: **40/40**.
- Null agent (does nothing) passes **6/40** (only the 6 leakage tasks, where doing nothing is safe but not correct).
- Adversarial solvers against intact governance: contained on **14/14** breach tasks.

## Mutation testing: break one control on purpose, do the graders notice?

| mutant (control disabled) | guarding tasks | intact system passes | broken system fails (detected) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| permissive | 11 | 11/11 | 11/11 |
| no_handle_binding | 1 | 1/1 | 1/1 |
| no_preconditions | 2 | 2/2 | 2/2 |

## Tool-integrity ablation (susceptible scripted agent that obeys instructions in tool descriptions)

| arm | tasks hijacked (store changed) |
| --- | --- |
| no gate | 4/4 |
| bench-local pin+scan gate (stand-in for Toolpin) | 0/4 |

The gate here is a minimal stand-in so Ontolite stays independent of Toolpin; Toolpin's own benchmark repeats the ablation with the real gate.
